programme.name: AI Foundations
programme.summary: Eight one-hour sessions that take everyone from "what is this?" to building their own tools and skills, and sharing them with the team. It's about getting your real work done faster, not creative work.
outcomes: Everyone using Claude on their real work, every day
Time back on the admin that eats your week
Everyone able to build their own small tools and repeatable skills
The best of them shared across the whole team
programme.slot: Session 1 on Mon 2 Nov, then Tuesdays. 5:30pm Sydney · 7:30am Munich. 60 minutes. Every session recorded.
rules_of_engagement: Phones away, as close to airplane mode as you can get. Slack and email closed.
Expect to be called on at random to share a win, so have one ready.
Miss a session? Watch the recording (1.25x is fine) before the next one.
Homework is light: one small thing a week. The only thing you hand in is the Time · Money · Pain form.

The Slack channel is meant to be loud. Post what you make, half-finished included. Everyone's at a different level, so nothing is embarrassing. We only rise together when we can all see what everyone is doing.
Stuck? Ask your Claude first. Then the channel. Then Jem.
every_session: Recording, one-page cheat sheet, wrap notes, homework and links on the session page
Fridays: a "show what you made" thread in the channel, plus the hub spotlight
Two or three people share a win from their week
The strongest users help out in Slack and at office hours
programme.big5_note: Not on the team side of the hub. The Big 5 ops projects run separately with their owners (Backstage only).

time_money_pain.intro: Three processes from your job. The one that takes the most time, the one that costs the most, and the one that annoys you most. It takes about 5 minutes and it shapes every session from here.

questions.q: TIME: the process that takes up the most of your time. What is it?
Roughly how many hours a week?
MONEY: the process that costs Two Palms the most (time billed, errors, rework, missed revenue). What is it?
Roughly how many hours a week?
PAIN: the process that annoys you most. What is it?
Roughly how many hours a week?
Which tools do these live in? (Slack, Gmail, Drive, Sheets, Productive, Monday, Notion, other)
If Claude could take one of these off your plate tomorrow, which one?
